kultivator.kota.kota.inspired: Inspired by Battle Through the Heavens: the Mi Te Auction House of Wu Tan City, where Xiao Yan sells pills at auction, and the lawless Black Corner Region with its black markets; and by the Shang Clan City of Reverend Insanity, a trading city where Gu Masters buy and sell. The town plan, prices and numbers are game design.
kultivator.kota.teh.inspired: Inspired by the teahouses and inns of wuxia and xianxia tales, where the news of the martial world goes round; game design.
kultivator.kota.pengembara.source: Source: Liaozhai Zhiyi, 'The Taoist of Mount Lao': Wang Qi climbs Mount Lao to learn the arts from a Taoist, and goes home with only a little of what he asked for. Inspired by the lone rogue cultivators who wander in A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality. The Dao discussion, sparring and rewards are game design.
kultivator.kota.saingan.inspired: Inspired by Battle Through the Heavens: the struggle for the Green Lotus Core Flame in the Tagore Desert, where Xiao Yan faces Queen Medusa and the snake people; and by the many cultivators racing for a newborn treasure in xianxia stories. Group names, grudges and numbers are game design.
kultivator.kota.kota_abadi.source: Source: Journey to the West chapters 4-5: Sun Wukong is brought to the Heavenly Palace, made keeper of the heavenly horses and then guardian of the Garden of Immortal Peaches, and eats the peaches of immortality. Inspired by the immortals' cities of A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality: Immortal Realm. The city, lectures and numbers are game design.
kultivator.kota.tiba: You arrive at %s. No blood is spilled inside the walls: your Good Name in this town is kept.
kultivator.kota.tiba_abadi: The clouds part: %s lies before you, the city of immortals above a sea of clouds.
kultivator.kota.warga.kata.0: They say tonight's dusk auction has a rare pill. Everyone is talking about it.
kultivator.kota.warga.kata.1: Don't fight here. The sect's guards don't like trouble.
kultivator.kota.warga.kata.2: The teahouse by the pond knows every rumour, if you're willing to pay.
kultivator.kota.warga.kata.3: The coffin shop down the road? I've never seen anyone actually buy a coffin there.
kultivator.kota.warga.kata.4: My grandfather says a dragon once flew over this town.
kultivator.kota.warga.kata.5: The harvest was good this year. The Qi around town feels thicker.
kultivator.kota.warga.kata.6: At night, keep to the streets with lanterns.
kultivator.kota.warga.kata.7: Cultivators come and go, but us common folk stay.
kultivator.kota.warga.kata.8: The notice board on the square has new work every day.
kultivator.kota.warga.kata.9: I hear a band of cultivators fought outside town yesterday.
kultivator.kota.warga.kata.10: The pill merchant is honest; his prices aren't.
kultivator.kota.warga.kata.11: Welcome, honoured cultivator. May your road be smooth.
kultivator.kota.saingan.kata.0: Step aside. Our business isn't with you.
kultivator.kota.saingan.kata.1: You smell the treasure too? Forget it.
kultivator.kota.saingan.kata.2: Our group never forgets who stood in our way.
kultivator.kota.saingan.kata.3: In the world of cultivation, the strong devour the weak.
kultivator.kota.saingan.kata.4: Hmph. Your realm is passable… for now.
kultivator.kota.saingan.kata.5: Pray we don't meet near the next treasure.
kultivator.kota.abadi.kata.0: Mortal dust made it up here too? Heaven is wide indeed.
kultivator.kota.abadi.kata.1: A thousand years below is a single day above the clouds.
kultivator.kota.abadi.kata.2: The Dao lecture in the Dao Pavilion begins when the sun is at its height.
kultivator.kota.abadi.kata.3: The peaches in that garden ripen in their own time, not yours.
kultivator.kota.abadi.kata.4: An Origin Stone is worth more than a thousand spirit stones.
kultivator.kota.abadi.kata.5: The tower bell rings at noon. Listen, then be still.
kultivator.kota.abadi.kata.6: The Jade Emperor's envoy seeks someone useful. Perhaps you.
kultivator.kota.abadi.kata.7: The road of immortality does not end here. Here it begins.
kultivator.kota.nama_baik.ditolak: Your Good Name in this town is too poor: they refuse to serve you.
kultivator.kota.nama_baik.turun: You attacked a townsperson: Good Name −%s (now %s).
kultivator.kota.nama_baik.bunuh: Blood was spilled inside the town walls: Good Name −%s (now %s). The guards remember your face.
kultivator.kota.nama_baik.saksi: A witness saw you kill that wanderer: Good Name −%s (now %s).
kultivator.kota.aksi.jauh: Too far away: walk back to them.
kultivator.kota.kurang_batu: Not enough spirit stones: you need %s.

kultivator.kota.toko.kunjungi: The Pill Merchant is in the Pill Pavilion and the Treasure Smith in the Treasure Pavilion: talk to them to shop.
kultivator.kota.toko.kosong: The shelves are empty today. New stock comes tomorrow.
kultivator.kota.toko.tangan: In your hand: %s ×%s, bought for %s SV.
kultivator.kota.toko.tangan_kosong: Hold the item you want to sell.
kultivator.kota.toko.tidak_beli: This merchant does not buy that.
kultivator.kota.toko.batas_jual: The merchant only buys %s stacks from you per day.
kultivator.kota.lelang.mati: Town auctions are off in the settings.
kultivator.kota.lelang.sudah_hari_ini: Today's session is over. Come back tomorrow at dusk.
kultivator.kota.lelang.berikut: The next session opens at dusk, in %s.
kultivator.kota.lelang.di_panggung: the auctioneer must see you (≤ 20 blocks)
kultivator.kota.lelang.kosong: The stage is still empty. Five lots are shown at dusk; four bidders from the rival groups bid too.
kultivator.kota.lelang.tip_tawar: Bid %s SV. Your stones: %s SV. Stones are taken only if you win.
kultivator.kota.lelang.tip_titip: Up to %s items per session; paid at the end at 0.7-1.3 × their value (at most half a lot's base).
kultivator.kota.lelang.mulai: The bell rings in the Auction House of %s: the dusk auction begins!
kultivator.kota.lelang.gagal_bayar: You won, but your stones fell short: the lot is cancelled and you may not bid again this session.
kultivator.kota.lelang.tidak_ada: No lot is open for bids.
kultivator.kota.lelang.usang: Your bid is stale: the price already rose. Look again.
kultivator.kota.lelang.titip_penuh: You already consigned %s items this session.
kultivator.kota.lelang.titip_tolak: The auction house does not accept that.
kultivator.kota.lelang.dititip: %s consigned; paid at the end of the session.
kultivator.kota.lelang.utang_dibayar: The auction house pays your pending consignment: %s.
kultivator.kota.teh.efek.embun: +%s %% XP while meditating for 10 in-game minutes.
kultivator.kota.teh.efek.awan: +%s %% Dao comprehension for 10 in-game minutes (Golden Core and up).
kultivator.kota.teh.efek.penenang: Heart Demon pressure rises 20 %% slower for 10 in-game minutes (Nascent Soul and up).
kultivator.kota.teh.tip_harga: Price: %s SV. Only one tea works at a time; a new one replaces the old.
kultivator.kota.teh.tip_bungkus: Take a cup with you (an item) to drink later.
kultivator.kota.teh.di_kedai: Order tea and rumours from the Tea Master.
kultivator.kota.teh.tip_token: The tea master only whispers to loyal guests: hear 3 rumours first (you heard %s).
kultivator.kota.teh.minum: You drink %s: it works for %s in-game minutes.
kultivator.kota.teh.ranah: This tea is too strong for you: it needs %s.
kultivator.kota.teh.suara.sambut: Please sit, the tea is freshly brewed.
kultivator.kota.teh.token_belum: The tea master shakes his head: "We don't know each other well enough yet." (hear %s rumours first)
kultivator.kota.teh.token_bisik: The tea master slips a black token into your hand: "The coffin shop. The back door. Tell no one."
kultivator.kota.teh.token_tawar: The tea master gives you a long look: "You come often… If you seek goods no shelf sells, ask me for a token."
kultivator.kota.kabar.judul: Rumours: pick a kind of place, then the distance.
kultivator.kota.kabar.tip: Marks one place you have not found on the World Map. If heaven will birth a treasure within a day, the tea master tells you its direction.
kultivator.kota.kabar.harta: The tea master lowers his voice: "The sky to the %s feels strange… some %s blocks from here. Something is about to be born."
kultivator.kota.kabar.tunggu: The tea master has no fresh news. Try again in %s seconds.
kultivator.kota.kabar.kosong: Nobody knows of a %s nearby. Your stones are returned.
kultivator.kota.kabar.sudah: You already know every %s nearby. Your stones are returned.
kultivator.kota.kabar.situs: Rumour: there is a %s to the %s, about %s blocks away (%s, %s). It is now on your World Map.
kultivator.kota.catatan.lore.0: Note: "Under the cliff that faces the sunset, the stones whisper when it rains."
kultivator.kota.catatan.lore.1: Note: "I was once lost in Qi mist for three days. When I came out, I had gained a stage."
kultivator.kota.catatan.lore.2: Note: "Never accept tea from a wanderer who smiles too widely."
kultivator.kota.catatan.lore.3: Note: "A rainbow pillar means a treasure is born. A rainbow pillar also means corpses."
kultivator.kota.catatan.lore.4: Note: "The guardians of ancestral tombs test patience, not strength."
kultivator.kota.catatan.lore.5: Note: "The immortal cities float above the clouds. Mortal dust may not be carried up."
kultivator.kota.catatan.lore.6: Note: "Mount Lao taught me to pass through walls. The first wall at home bumped my head."
kultivator.kota.catatan.lore.7: Note: "The longest road begins with the step beneath your feet."
kultivator.kota.berita.langit.meteor_sho: A spirit meteor shower falls tonight; the sky-stone hunters are heading for the plains.
kultivator.kota.berita.langit.blood_ecli: A blood moon… heaven is angry, the guards are restless, and black-market prices rise.
kultivator.kota.berita.langit.twin_moons: Two moons in the sky! The elders say tonight's Qi is thicker than usual.
kultivator.kota.berita.evolusi: %s led %s through a beast tribulation to tier %s.
kultivator.kota.berita.segel_pecah: The seal of an ancient demon prison %s has broken! Don't leave town alone.
kultivator.kota.berita.segel_retak: The seal of an ancient demon prison %s is badly cracked. Whispers rise from under the ground.
kultivator.kota.berita.segel_lemah: The seal of an ancient demon prison %s is starting to weaken.
kultivator.kota.berita.segel_utuh: Someone resealed an ancient demon prison %s. The sky is calm again.
kultivator.kota.gelap.judul: The Market under the Coffin Shop
kultivator.kota.gelap.bisikan: There are whispers of a market under the coffin shop… Its broker only trades down there, and its door only opens for a holder of a Black Market Token.
kultivator.kota.gelap.tip_beli: No realm gate, 1.5 × the price. Every purchase has a %s %% chance to bring a guard raid.
kultivator.kota.gelap.razia_sisa: The door is guarded, the raid ends in %s
kultivator.kota.gelap.tangan: In your hand: %s, the broker pays %s SV.
kultivator.kota.gelap.pintu_dijaga: The sect's guards stand before the door: not now.
kultivator.kota.gelap.pintu_diam: This coffin rack feels too solid… as if it hides something.
kultivator.kota.gelap.pintu_buka: The token in your hand grows warm. The coffin rack slides aside without a sound.
kultivator.kota.gelap.ditolak: The broker does not deal with someone the guards are hunting.
kultivator.kota.gelap.suara.bisik: Fine goods… for those who know how to keep quiet.
kultivator.kota.gelap.suara.razia: Halt! This town is under the sect's protection.
kultivator.kota.gelap.razia: RAID! The sect's guards storm the black market and hunt you. Pay %s SV to a guard (right-click one) or hold out for 60 seconds.
kultivator.kota.gelap.suap_tawar: The guard eyes your purse: "%s, and I never saw you."
kultivator.kota.gelap.tidak_razia: There is no raid to bribe your way out of.
kultivator.kota.gelap.suap_terima: The guard pockets your stones and looks away. The raid is over.
kultivator.kota.misi.mati: The notice board is off in the settings.
kultivator.kota.misi.isi.buru: An elite demon beast roams near the town. Slay it.
kultivator.kota.misi.isi.kemah: Rogue cultivators camp by the trade road. Drive them all off.
kultivator.kota.misi.isi.herba: The town's healer needs a spirit herb old enough. Bring one to the board.
kultivator.kota.misi.isi.kawal: A merchant wants to reach the nearest town or village safely.
kultivator.kota.misi.aktif_selesai: Bounty done: %s. Turn it in at the board!
kultivator.kota.misi.di_papan: Bounties are taken and turned in with a Town Guard near the board.
kultivator.kota.misi.sudah_ada: Finish or cancel your current bounty first.
kultivator.kota.misi.batas: You already took %s bounties today, across all towns.
kultivator.kota.misi.sudah_diambil: Someone else already took that bounty.
kultivator.kota.misi.tidak_bisa: That bounty cannot start here right now.
kultivator.kota.misi.buru_mulai: The demon beast's tracks lead %s, about %s blocks away. It is waiting for you.
kultivator.kota.misi.buru_selesai: The demon beast has fallen. Return to the notice board for your reward.
kultivator.kota.misi.kemah_mulai: A bandit camp was reported to the %s, around %s, %s.
kultivator.kota.misi.kemah_selesai: The bandit camp is cleared. Return to the notice board for your reward.
kultivator.kota.misi.herba_mulai: Bring a spirit herb aged %s years or more to the notice board.
kultivator.kota.misi.herba_kurang: Your herb is not old enough: it needs %s years.
kultivator.kota.misi.kawal_mulai: Escort this merchant to the %s, about %s blocks. Do not let them fall behind or die.
kultivator.kota.misi.kawal_tujuan_tidak_: There is no other town or village near enough to go to.
kultivator.kota.misi.kawal_selesai: The merchant arrived safely and thanks you. Return to the notice board for your reward.
kultivator.kota.misi.kawal_gagal: The merchant you escorted died. The bounty failed.
kultivator.kota.misi.kawal_waktu: You took too long: the merchant gave up and went home. The bounty failed.
kultivator.kota.misi.belum: Your bounty is not done yet.
kultivator.kota.pengembara.sapa.0.0: Greetings, fellow traveller of the road. Sit a while?
kultivator.kota.pengembara.sapa.0.1: One rarely meets anyone on this quiet road. How goes your cultivation?
kultivator.kota.pengembara.sapa.0.2: Today's wind carries good Qi. Let us share our views.
kultivator.kota.pengembara.sapa.1.0: Hmph. You dare stand in my way?
kultivator.kota.pengembara.sapa.1.1: Your realm… passable for someone like you.
kultivator.kota.pengembara.sapa.1.2: If you want to learn from me, first show you are worthy.
kultivator.kota.pengembara.sapa.2.0: Ah, friend! I have something you might like…
kultivator.kota.pengembara.sapa.2.1: This road is dangerous. Safer if we walk together, no?
kultivator.kota.pengembara.sapa.2.2: Heh… your purse looks heavy. Very heavy.
kultivator.kota.pengembara.bicara_tip: Talk to this wanderer: exchange knowledge, spar, challenge, or invite them along.
kultivator.kota.pengembara.suara.dao: Our roads differ. Let us share our views.
kultivator.kota.pengembara.tidak_ada: No wanderer waits for you nearby.
kultivator.kota.pertemuan.tip_tanding: A friendly duel: it stops when either side is at 10 %% health. Win: 2 %% of the bar as XP, a Wanderer's Badge, +3 Good Name. Lose: nothing lost.
kultivator.kota.pertemuan.tip_tantang: A fight to the death. They become your enemy; slain, they drop a loot pouch. If someone sees it, the nearest town's Good Name drops by 10.
kultivator.kota.pertemuan.tip_ajak: Friendly wanderers only, for Golden Core and up: they follow you for one in-game day, fight monsters, then leave with a small gift.
kultivator.kota.tanding.mulai: The sparring match begins! It stops at 10 %% health.
kultivator.kota.tanding.menang: You beat %s in the sparring match. They bow and give you a Wanderer's Badge.
kultivator.kota.tanding.kalah: %s won the sparring match. You lose nothing but a little pride.
kultivator.kota.tantang.mulai: %s accepts your challenge. Killing intent fills the air!
kultivator.kota.ajak.tolak: This wanderer will not travel with you.
kultivator.kota.ajak.sudah: A wanderer already travels with you.
kultivator.kota.ajak.ikut: %s travels with you for a day.
kultivator.kota.ajak.pergi: %s says goodbye and leaves you a small gift.
kultivator.kota.diskusi.tip_beri.giok: Offer a jade slip to discuss. It is returned if you lose the discussion.
kultivator.kota.diskusi.tip_beri.herba: Offer a spirit herb. It is returned if you lose the discussion.
kultivator.kota.diskusi.tip_beri.pil: Offer a pill. It is returned if you lose the discussion.
kultivator.kota.diskusi.tip_beri.pengala: Offer your experience: 5 %% of your current cultivation bar. It is returned if you lose the discussion.
kultivator.kota.diskusi.tidak_punya.peng: Your cultivation bar is not full enough.
kultivator.kota.diskusi.kurang_pengalama: Your cultivation bar is not full enough to share.
kultivator.kota.diskusi.batas: You already discussed %s times today. Your mind needs rest.
kultivator.kota.diskusi.tip_sikap.gerak: Motion beats Stillness. Listen to the hint: which way do they lean?
kultivator.kota.diskusi.tip_sikap.diam: Stillness beats Harmony. Listen to the hint: which way do they lean?
kultivator.kota.diskusi.tip_sikap.selara: Harmony beats Motion. Listen to the hint: which way do they lean?
kultivator.kota.diskusi.hasil.catatan: Their Dao is not your road, but they give you a Wanderer's Note.
kultivator.kota.diskusi.hasil.lore: You lost the discussion and your offer is returned. They say: %s
kultivator.kota.diskusi.ajak: After the discussion you may spar, part ways, or travel together.
kultivator.kota.diskusi.lore.0: "Water does not contend, yet it wears down stone."
kultivator.kota.diskusi.lore.1: "Who rushes up the mountain falls on the first slope."
kultivator.kota.diskusi.lore.2: "Wang Qi wanted the arts without the work. He went home with a bump on his head."
kultivator.kota.diskusi.lore.3: "The Dao that can be spoken is not the eternal Dao."
kultivator.kota.diskusi.lore.4: "Your sword is sharp, but your heart is still dull."
kultivator.kota.diskusi.lore.5: "Come back when you understand why you lost."
kultivator.kota.diskusi.sword.2: "The finest sword stays in its sheath."
kultivator.kota.diskusi.sword.5: "Follow the foe's line, then cut through its gap."
kultivator.kota.diskusi.fire.0: "A fire that does not move dies out."
kultivator.kota.diskusi.fire.2: "The ember under the ash is hotter than the flame."
kultivator.kota.diskusi.fire.3: "A pill furnace needs a patient fire."
kultivator.kota.diskusi.fire.5: "The best fire warms, it does not burn."
kultivator.kota.diskusi.ice.2: "A frozen lake keeps a thousand seasons."
kultivator.kota.diskusi.ice.4: "Ice melts to water, water freezes to ice."
kultivator.kota.diskusi.ice.5: "Snow falls the way the wind goes."
kultivator.kota.diskusi.lightning.1: "The swiftest wins before the foe knows it."
kultivator.kota.diskusi.lightning.3: "Before the flash, heaven holds its breath."
kultivator.kota.diskusi.lightning.4: "Yin and yang meet, and lightning is born."
kultivator.kota.diskusi.body.2: "The mountain does not move, yet nothing shakes it."
kultivator.kota.diskusi.body.3: "Endure a thousand blows, then you understand."
kultivator.kota.diskusi.body.4: "Breath and bone must keep one rhythm."
kultivator.kota.diskusi.body.5: "A supple body does not break easily."
kultivator.kota.diskusi.life.3: "The old tree is wise because it is patient."
kultivator.kota.diskusi.life.5: "The forest lives by sharing the light."
kultivator.kota.diskusi.shadow.0: "A shadow that stays still is caught."
kultivator.kota.diskusi.shadow.5: "Follow the foe's steps like their own shadow."
kultivator.kota.diskusi.space.0: "Space folds for those who dare to step."
kultivator.kota.grup.0: The Mo Clan of Black Valley
kultivator.kota.grup.3: The Tie Clan of the North
kultivator.kota.grup.8: The Gu Clan of Mist Marsh
kultivator.kota.saingan.datang: Sword light descends from the sky: the %s come to fight for the treasure!
kultivator.kota.saingan.klaim: The %s seized the treasure before you.
kultivator.kota.saingan.niat_membunuh: Killing intent locks onto you from afar…
kultivator.kota.saingan.sergap: The %s ambush you for your treasure!
kultivator.kota.saingan.kalah: The leader of the %s falls. "We will return…"
kultivator.kota.saingan.semua: You have beaten all six rival leaders. Your name is now feared across the cultivation world.
kultivator.kota.abadi.fana: mortal dust: only the ascended may trade
kultivator.kota.abadi.ke_pasar: The Immortal Market's merchant trades in the city's market: talk to them.
kultivator.kota.abadi.langka: A rare ware, %s Origin Stones. The mining cap of 16 a day buys it in about a week.
kultivator.kota.abadi.kurang_asal: Not enough Immortal Origin Stones: you need %s.
kultivator.kota.kuliah.sekarang: The lecture is on! Sit near the lecturer.
kultivator.kota.kuliah.nanti: The next lecture is at noon, in %s.
kultivator.kota.kuliah.cara: Sit (sneak or meditate) within 6 blocks of the lecturer for 60 seconds at noon: +1-3 comprehension of your Dao, or an enlightenment if you have none. Once a day.
kultivator.kota.kuliah.suara: Listen. The Dao does not flow into a full cup.
kultivator.kota.kuliah.dengar: You listen to the Dao lecture: %s / %s seconds.
kultivator.kota.kuliah.pencerahan: The lecturer's words kindle something within you: an enlightenment!
kultivator.kota.persik.isi: The garden's keeper lets every immortal pick one peach every %s days. Eaten: 2 %% of the bar at Immortal Ascension, 5 %% at True Immortal, and half your health heals.
kultivator.kota.persik.siap: Your peach is ready to pick.
kultivator.kota.persik.ke_kebun: The keeper is in the Garden of Immortal Peaches.
kultivator.kota.persik.belum: No peach is ripe for you yet: %s more days.
kultivator.kota.persik.petik: You pick an Immortal Peach. Its scent alone calms the soul.
kultivator.kota.persik.makan: Sweet and everlasting: +%s %% of your cultivation bar.
kultivator.kota.titah.kosong: The Jade Emperor's envoy gives one edict every in-game week. Accept it to see the task.
kultivator.kota.titah.isi.batu: Offer %s Immortal Origin Stones to the Jade Palace.
kultivator.kota.titah.isi.mutiara: Bring %s Immortal Essence Pearls to the envoy.
kultivator.kota.titah.isi.purba: Defeat %s primordial beast or lord in the Immortal Realm.
kultivator.kota.titah.isi.musuh: Defeat %s enemies in the Immortal Realm.
kultivator.kota.titah.dibayar: This week's edict is paid. Come back next week.
kultivator.kota.titah.siap: Task done! Report it for %s Origin Stones.
kultivator.kota.titah.selesai: The envoy's edict is fulfilled. Report to the envoy in the Jade Palace.
kultivator.kota.titah.belum: This edict is not fulfilled yet.
kultivator.kota.titah.hadiah: The envoy nods: "The Jade Emperor is pleased." You receive %s Immortal Origin Stones.

item.kultivator.lencana_pengembara.toolt: A token of respect from a wanderer you beat in sparring.

item.kultivator.persik_abadi.source: Source: Journey to the West chapter 5: the Garden of Immortal Peaches has 3,600 trees whose fruit ripens every 3,000, 6,000 and 9,000 years and grants long life; Sun Wukong, its guardian, eats the peaches. The in-game effect is game design.

kultivator.screen.help.kota.title: Cultivator Town
kultivator.screen.help.kota: Cultivator Town: a walled town born with the world in new chunks (about 130 × 130 blocks), with a paifang gate, a square, an Auction House, the Bamboo Wind Pavilion teahouse, a Pill Pavilion, a Treasure Pavilion, an inn, the guard sect's office and a coffin shop. Its people appear as you come near (at most 10) and leave when you go. Right-click a townsperson to trade. Shops sell goods around your realm and buy at 0.35-0.5 × the base price (16 stacks a day). The Auction House holds a session at dusk: five lots, four bidders from the rival groups, bid +5/+10/+25 %%, stones taken only if you win. The teahouse sells three teas (one at work at a time) and Rumours that mark places on the World Map. After three rumours the tea master sells a Black Market Token: the door behind the coffin rack opens and the broker sells without a realm gate at 1.5 × the price, but every purchase may bring a raid (pay a bribe or hold out 60 seconds). The Notice Board gives 3 bounties a day (hunt a beast, a bandit camp, an aged herb, escort a merchant). Good Name (−100 to 100) rises with bounties and auctions and falls when you hurt townsfolk; below −30 the guards turn on you, from 50 on you get a 10 %% discount. Mode Kehancuran cannot damage a town. Inspired by Battle Through the Heavens: the Mi Te Auction House of Wu Tan City, where Xiao Yan sells pills at auction, and the lawless Black Corner Region with its black markets; and by the Shang Clan City of Reverend Insanity, a trading city where Gu Masters buy and sell. The town plan, prices and numbers are game design.
kultivator.screen.help.pengembara.title: Wandering Cultivators
kultivator.screen.help.pengembara: Wandering Cultivators: from Qi Refining on, a wanderer sometimes walks up to you outdoors (at most once a day), and some sit in teahouses. Their realm is close to yours; their temper Friendly, Proud or Cunning. Click [Talk] in chat or right-click them. Exchange Knowledge: offer a jade slip, a herb, a pill or 5 %% of your bar, then a three-round Dao Discussion: Motion beats Stillness, Stillness beats Harmony, Harmony beats Motion, and their hint tells which way they lean (cunning ones often lie). Win 2-3 rounds: +2-6 comprehension of their Dao if it is yours, or a Wanderer's Note. Lose: a word of advice and your offer back. Three discussions a day. Spar: a duel that stops at 10 %% health; winning gives 2 %% of the bar as XP, a Wanderer's Badge and Good Name. Challenge: they become your enemy to the death. Travel Together (Friendly, Golden Core and up): they follow you for a day and fight monsters. Area techniques never hit a peaceful wanderer. Source: Liaozhai Zhiyi, 'The Taoist of Mount Lao': Wang Qi climbs Mount Lao to learn the arts from a Taoist, and goes home with only a little of what he asked for. Inspired by the lone rogue cultivators who wander in A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality. The Dao discussion, sparring and rewards are game design.
kultivator.screen.help.saingan.title: Rival Cultivators
kultivator.screen.help.saingan: Rival Cultivators: six groups of cultivators (clans, sects, pavilions) live in this world, each with a leader, members, a region and a fighting style. Their realm grows with the world's days but never more than one realm above the strongest player who played lately. When heaven births a treasure, the groups whose region is near join the race: if you are near the treasure they descend from the sky on swords, fight each other and try to channel the treasure for 5 seconds. They attack anyone who claims the treasure or attacks them. After you take a treasure, a group that holds a grudge against you (or a cunning one) may ambush you 1-5 minutes later outside a town; towns are always safe. At most one ambush a day. A beaten leader drops a Rival's Pouch and their grudge falls to 20. The four bidders in every Auction House belong to these groups too. Inspired by Battle Through the Heavens: the struggle for the Green Lotus Core Flame in the Tagore Desert, where Xiao Yan faces Queen Medusa and the snake people; and by the many cultivators racing for a newborn treasure in xianxia stories. Group names, grudges and numbers are game design.
kultivator.screen.help.kota_abadi.title: Immortal City
kultivator.screen.help.kota_abadi: Immortal City: a floating district in the Immortal Realm (height 150-170), for the ascended only. The Cloud Gate, the Immortal Market, the Dao Pavilion, the Garden of Immortal Peaches, the Bell Tower, the Immortal Auction House and the Jade Palace. The Immortal Market sells immortal herbs, Immortal Pills, essence pearls and sometimes primordial materials for Immortal Origin Stones; the mining cap of 16 a day buys a rare ware in about a week. The Dao Lecture at noon: sit within 6 blocks of the lecturer for 60 seconds for +1-3 comprehension of your Dao (once a day). An Immortal Peach every 3 days: 2 %% of the bar at Immortal Ascension, 5 %% at True Immortal. Its auctioneer opens the existing Immortal Auction. The Jade Emperor's envoy gives one edict a week, paid in Origin Stones. The tower's bell rings at noon. Source: Journey to the West chapters 4-5: Sun Wukong is brought to the Heavenly Palace, made keeper of the heavenly horses and then guardian of the Garden of Immortal Peaches, and eats the peaches of immortality. Inspired by the immortals' cities of A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality: Immortal Realm. The city, lectures and numbers are game design.
